title: Start a Repository
story: Your new project is just a loose folder. Put it under version control and save the first snapshot.
goal: Turn the folder into a repository and make your first commit containing hello.py.

tests.label: hello.py is saved in the commit

hints: A folder becomes a repository with git init.
git init, git add hello.py, git commit -m "message".

Run:
git init
git add hello.py
git commit -m "first commit"
socratic: Which command shows you the evidence you need?
explain: In one sentence: what was the cause, and how did you fix it?
